answer_1.quote: We synthetically generate the Hinglish sentences using two different approaches ... leveraging popular English‑Hindi parallel corpus. ... The first subtask is predicting the quality rating of the code‑mixed text.

answer_2.quote: We use the following three evaluation metrics: • F1-score (FS): ... • Cohen's Kappa (CK): ... • Mean Squared Error (MSE): ... For the first subtask, we use all three metrics, whereas we use FS and MSE to evaluate the second subtask.

answer_4.quote: We employ eight human annotators to provide a rating between 1 (low quality) to 10 (high quality) to the generated Hinglish sentences. ... The rating depends on the following three factors: 1. The similarity between the generated Hinglish sentence and the source sentences. 2. The readability of the generated sentence. 3. The grammatical correctness of the generated sentence.
answer_4.guideline: Annotation guidelines to rate the sentences (rating scale 1‑10 and three quality factors).
